name: CarrierRateCardManager
tagline: Keep every carrier's lane rates, fuel tables, accessorials and validity in one Power Apps component – and always know who is cheapest on a lane once fuel is added.
description: A complete carrier rate card desk for shippers, 3PLs and brokers: lane rate lines per carrier rate card (per mile, flat or per cwt with minimums), fuel surcharge step tables driven by the diesel price, accessorial schedules with carrier overrides, validity windows with expiry warnings and automatic end-dating of overlapping rates, approval rules for increases and above-market rates, amendments, card renewals with uplift, a lane comparison that ranks carriers by all-in cost into a routing guide, a validity timeline and a dashboard of coverage gaps. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Per-mile, flat and per-cwt rates with minimum charges
Fuel surcharge step tables driven by the diesel price; LTL fuel %
Accessorial schedule with carrier overrides and a comparison matrix
Approval rules: increase vs previous, above-market tolerance, long spot rates
Automatic end-dating / superseding of overlapping rates on activation
Amendments instead of in-place changes; card renewal with uplift
Extend with limits; suspend / resume / expire with reasons
Lane comparison ranking carriers as primary and backups (RoutingGuideJson)
Bulk submit, approve, extend, rate change, assign, expire + undo
Keyboard and phone layout with bottom bar
RatesCsv, RoutingGuideJson and SummaryJson for flows
Demo mode with fictional sample data
